config.magazine_casing.enableMagazineDro: If true, reloading a magazine-fed gun from empty spawns a dropped magazine entity.
config.magazine_casing.magazineDespawnTi: How many ticks a dropped magazine stays in the world before despawning (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.magazine_casing.magazineDropBlack: Gun IDs that must never drop a magazine on empty reload.
